name: DoseClear BD
model_pipeline: Tesseract OCR + semantic medicine-name matching to pharmacist-reviewed dictionary

model_candidates.name: Tesseract OCR with ben+eng language packs
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Extract Bangla digits/Latin amounts from owned sample image; low-confidence flag

model_candidates.name: sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2
model_candidates.must_smoke_test: Encode two real Bengali strings and assert different finite vectors; search should return expected source ID

evaluation: Medication text exact-match; dose numeral error rate; abstention on illegible
bangladesh_data_plan: Consented patient prescriptions (no shared training without opt-in), DGDA reference links
hard_safety_limit: Never fill missing dosage, expiry, or change treatment
simple_user_flow: photo/paste > correct text > questions to doctor
advanced_features: large-type summary, user correction, source-linked medicine caution
